flash-next-strata-solo-thinking-recovery.note: New on 2026-10-17, one variable from the card-sampling configuration of the day; since the 2026-10-18 consolidation it is the oldest link the Strata chain has left, and the configuration the retired greedy, card-sampling and route-tail-skip ids name in their refusal: TOOL_CALL_RECOVERY=on. Pinned from the day it exists, so a later edit to either configuration moves a digest here rather than going unnoticed. Re-pinned on 2026-10-17 again for three variables this container is now told through and nothing else moved: --conversation-cache-mib and --conversation-cache-min-free-mib, both stating off here, and --ple-gguf stating off. Stating off is what tells the entry point to take the flags out of the run config it wrote on an earlier boot; the three lines are here so every configuration of this engine says what the workspace it shares is left holding.

This one does need the image this revision pins, because the flags go into the engine's run config and only this house's entry point can write there.
